neper.notes: The baseline: the theme's own grid (look.on false), the same two sheets.

windows.notes: datagrid.build applies gridlook.v3() under the Windows profile (unless the application set a look), so no per-app wiring. Sheet: a flat list (header, filter row, stripes, selected row, vertical scroll bar, summary footer) and a grouped grid (group row with the plus/minus box and summaries), in the #F0F0F0 form face, rendered at 100 % and 150 %; windows/data_grid-vs-ref@1.5x.png has a crop of the v3 deck capture (03-main-pool-deck-v3.png) on the left. Row pitch 19 (28.5 at 150 %), header 21, #FFFFFF/#EFEFEF stripes, #A6D2FF selection with its #83878B edge match the capture; the measured parity itself is docs/grid-parity.
gaps: No reference at 100 % (v3 captures are at 150 % only); the 100 % sheet is the 150 % measurement scaled
Reference is a crop of the main window with a different data set (icons, navigator bar, band tabs), so the comparison is of metrics and colours, not pixel for pixel
The 1 px frame (#828790) is painted under the header and rows on the top and left and shows only on the right and bottom of the grid box (existing datagrid layout, not touched here)
Footer: the summary cells sit on a grey band with a yellow gap, v3 has a yellow band with grey summary cells only where a summary exists; footer sums are not rounded to the column format ($1595)
Scroll bar is the grid's thin thumb on a #F0F0F0 track; v3's native scroll bar arrow buttons are not drawn
Hover and pressed rows, the unfocused selection (#D5E4EE) and the filter row's operator icons are the grid lane's, not shown on this sheet
Text is the theme's Segoe UI at the grid look's 10.35 px; v3's cell font face (Tahoma?) is not confirmed

neper.notes: The baseline: collection.tree_table, the existing v2 tree table, same two sheets.

windows.notes: collection.tree_table under the Windows profile takes gridlook.v3() as its table look: 19 px rows, white / #EFEFEF stripes counted over the visible rows, no rules, the #A6D2FF selection with its edge, the grid's header (21 px, white, #C6C6C6 line), a 20 px indent and the grid's plus and minus boxes as twisties (the DevExpress Office11 expand button). v3's only tree list is tlAbilities in filter.vcl.form.dfm: lfOffice11, NativeStyle, MultiSelect, no tree lines, ColumnAutoWidth, Styles from the TreeList stylesheet (selection #A6D2FF, even #EFEFEF, odd white). Sheet: three columns and levels with a selected leaf, and a one column list in the filter form's shape.
gaps: No capture of any v3 tree list exists: the look is the grid's measured look applied to the tree by the shared stylesheet colours, not a measured tree list
The expand box is the grid's (grey frame, black plus, flat white); the capture of the grid's group box shows a navy (#2C4574) plus and a light gradient fill

ShowRoot = False (no expander or indent on the first level) and CheckGroups (check boxes on the nodes) of tlAbilities are not drawn; TreeOptions has no flag for them and the check box control has no Windows look yet
Indent 20 px is the DevExpress default, not measured
Row text is the theme's body text, not the grid's 10.35 px
Header has no sort glyph or hover colour on this sheet; the inactive-focus selection colours (#ECE9D8 and the grid's #D5E4EE) are not applied
Plain tree and outline (no columns) keep the Neper look
No 100 % or 150 % reference to compare against

neper.notes: The baseline: collection.property_grid_of, the existing v2 property grid with group headings, same two sheets.

windows.notes: collection.property_grid_of under the Windows profile: 19 px rows, a #F0F0F0 row header column with black Segoe UI names, white value cells, 1 px #A0A0A4 (clMedGray, the DFM's GridLineColor) lines between header and value and under each row, the selected row's header #A6D2FF, category rows a #F0F0F0 band 21 px tall with a plus/minus box and a bold caption. Row header 164 and 330 wide as in deck_properties.vcl.form.dfm (vgProperties: lfOffice11, NativeStyle, CategoryExplorerStyle, Tahoma 8). Sheet: the Deck Properties rows (name text editing, read-only text, combo box, button-edit text, spin edit, check box) with all categories open, and with two shut.
gaps: No capture of v3's vertical grid exists: everything except the line colour (DFM) and the 164 px header width is a DevExpress Office11 default from memory
CategoryExplorerStyle (Explorer-bar category rows) is approximated by a flat band; the real band, its arrow glyph and any gradient are not drawn
The selected row colour (#A6D2FF, from the other v3 stylesheets) is a guess: the vertical grid's own Selection style is empty in the DFM

In v3 only the focused row shows an editor and the others show plain text (and a check glyph); the sheet puts real editors in the combo, spin and check rows, drawn with Neper looks until those controls have Windows looks, so they are 22+ px tall and grow their rows
TcxMultiEditorRow (Deck/Sideboard, land/creature/spell counts), image combo images, hyperlink and date editors and the row hint are not drawn
The splitter between header and value is a 1 px line; the draggable divider (options.divide) shows no cursor or hover colour
Collapsed categories show no property count; keyboard focus ring on a row is not drawn
No 100 % or 150 % reference to compare against
